featured_reviews.name: steve dsouza
featured_reviews.review_text:
If you’re even remotely serious about your craft, do yourself a favour and stay away from this place. This is not a professional studio, it’s a venue awkwardly pretending to be one.

We shot at Studio 3 and the constant banging noises from the neighbouring facility made it borderline unusable for any sound recording. When this was brought up to the staff, instead of resolving it, they casually pointed at a board and told us to “call the manager.” So in the middle of an active shoot, we’re expected to call someone who isn’t even on-site, only to be told in a condescending tone that it’s from an establishment called Candies next door which which has an operational kitchen as if that somehow fixes the problem.

What’s worse is the on-ground staff hovering and staring at the backdrop roll while the talent is literally mid-shot on it. In any professional studio, you get reasonable usage of the roll and pay extra if needed, you don’t get policed like you’re damaging museum property. Having staff silently stare down your talent during a take is not just unprofessional, it’s absurd.

We also shot BTS and bytes in the common couch area, which they themselves position as a usable space, only for the hiring team to get a CCTV monitoring call saying they’ll be charged for sitting on the couch because it’s a “prop.” Monitoring clients over CCTV to penalise basic usage of space is petty and ridiculous.

I’ve shot in dozens of studios, some great, some average, some difficult, but never one that felt this hostile, rigid, and poorly managed. Issues usually get solved through competent studio management. Here, the owner or manager Vicky seems fundamentally unsuited to run a studio environment.

For the price they charge, you can easily book a larger, better-equipped studio with proper sound control, basic professionalism, and staff who actually understand how shoots function. This place is a logistical headache masquerading as a studio.

What Is an Engagement Shoot?

An engagement shoot is a pre-wedding photo session where a couple captures beautiful moments together before their wedding day. It allows them to celebrate their engagement while creating natural, romantic, and candid photographs in a relaxed setting. These photos can be used for wedding invitations, save-the-date cards, wedding websites, social media announcements, or displayed at the wedding reception.

An engagement shoot also helps couples become comfortable in front of the camera and build a connection with their photographer before the big day. Since there is no wedding-day pressure, couples can express their personalities, wear outfits they love, and choose meaningful locations such as parks, beaches, city streets, or places where they first met. The result is a collection of timeless images that reflect their unique love story and create lasting memories.

1. When should you schedule an engagement shoot?
Ideally, 3–8 months before your wedding.

2. What should we wear?
Choose coordinated, comfortable outfits in colors that complement each other without matching exactly.

3. How long does an engagement shoot take?
Most sessions last between 1 and 2 hours.

4. Where should the shoot take place?
Pick a location that has personal meaning or offers beautiful scenery, such as a park, beach, or urban setting.

5. Is an engagement shoot worth it?
Yes. It helps you feel more confident in front of the camera and provides memorable photos

On the day of the event, they were an absolute dream to work with. Their patience knew no bounds as they seamlessly mingled with the crowd, making everyone feel at ease. They effortlessly blended in as if they were a natural part of our event, and their friendly demeanor instantly put everyone at ease.

From start to finish, their organization and professionalism were evident. Ajaikiraan’s assistance throughout the process was invaluable. Highly recommended!

featured_reviews.name: Sujitha Lakshmi K
featured_reviews.review_text: We had a nice experience with Zero Gravity team. Great communication and they did a wonderful job in capturing great moments. Highly recommend them. Thank you for being a part of our memorable day!

featured_reviews.name: Sunil Manivannan
featured_reviews.review_text: We have a great time with Zero Gravity capturing the best memories of my sister's engagement and wedding. The entire team was kind and co-operative.  The quality of work was excellent. All the events were properly planned and executed.  Mr.Manigandan and his team ensured all our expectations are fulfilled. I am very satisfied with ZG.

featured_reviews.name: Samuel Robert
featured_reviews.review_text: Zero Gravity is very professional in terms of photography, i really loved the patience of their photographers during the outdoor candid shoot of our Kid . Special mention on their deliverables it looks great and class. I would recommend highly if your planning for any kind of shoots.

featured_reviews.name: Ram Nagarajan
featured_reviews.review_text:
Engaged zero gravity team for a family event. Third time associating with them and will continue to do so. They're one of the best in the field.
Would definitely recommend their services ! Be sure to discuss and customize according to your needs and budget.
Thanks to Manikandan (candid shots photographer) and his team for covering the event. Ajaikiraan from the post production team followed up regularly and kept a clear line of communication to keep us happy with the deliverables.
